procedure: Three sequential fix cycles per disposable fixture on the same Linux host. All variants use the same release Zellij binary, current evidence report and stub agents. Baseline Swamp includes only resume compatibility and identical phase instrumentation; optimized Swamp also includes swamp-warm-transitions.patch. Measurements use terminal button input and received terminal bytes. The optimized runs were serial, after builds and baseline runs finished.

boundaries.answerToQuestionMs: Begin review button input to received Show diff question bytes.
boundaries.answerToPromptMs: Start fix agent button input to the stub receiving the saved failure prompt.
boundaries.helperExitToQuestionMs: Stub exit stamp to received Begin review question bytes in a fresh run.
boundaries.agent.startupMs: Stub initialization after Python imports through SessionStart reporting.
boundaries.coldStartMs: Managed service bootstrap and readiness, outside warm transitions.
boundaries.methodWork: Method execution by workflow step, including that method's data writes. Continuations include child work and observation waits; durations overlap and must not be summed.
boundaries.priorRunReportCompletedAfterQuestionMs: Prior failed-test run report completion minus fresh question arrival, using the recorded wall/monotonic offset. Positive values show question delivery before report completion.

retainedHistory.failureOutput: Each measured cycle also retains its failing command output and report bodies.
